title: module comment in inbox.rs contradicts verify_http_signatures config behavior
description: The module doc comment for inbox.rs says 'Inbound HTTP Signature verification is not yet implemented — a future hardening pass will add it. For v1, we trust the actor field.' But the code does implement signature verification for Create activities (dispatched via inbound::verify_http_signature). The comment is stale and wrong. A contributor reading the module comment will assume the verification path is unimplemented and may try to implement it again or skip security review. Fix: update the doc comment to describe the actual state: Create activities are verified when verify_http_signatures=true, but Follow/Undo are not yet verified.
